title: OutpostClientState
description: Game-specific body of Outpost's per-viewer full-state send (Phase 3). This describes only the developer-written GetClientState() payload, not the generic StateWalker/envelope wrapper around it. Two valid shapes: pre-STARTGAME setup (options/players/myPlayerId/supplyShip/itemStock/commodityStock only) and the full in-game snapshot (everything else too, some fields nullable depending on state). supplyShip, itemStock, and commodityStock are the exceptions to the pre-STARTGAME/in-game split -- all three are always present (empty/zeroed before GetUnownedItems() is initialized, or simply reflecting CommodityManager's fixed constructor-time deck data for commodityStock) rather than being omitted like every other in-game field. spends is no longer part of this body at all -- see docs/Sequences.txt and OutpostSpendsSequenceSchema.json.

options.description: Game options as agreed during setup; fixed once the game starts.

players.description: Every player currently joined, in join order. This order is fixed for the life of the game; it is not turn order (turn order is a separate, dynamically-computed array -- see the existing TURNORDER event, not yet part of this schema). okstartup is meaningless (false) before ValidateSetup.

items.description: Every field is always present; most are simply harmless pre-game defaults (e.g. victoryPoints 0, purchaseState DONE) before the game actually starts, same as okstartup.

factoryDescription.description: Compact per-slot factory/manning summary, see Factories::GetFactoryDescription.

cardBackDescription.description: Public (non-secret) commodity-hand summary visible to all viewers.

myPlayerId.description: This viewer's own player id, or null if the viewer is watching but not seated.

itemStock.description: Remaining count in the central item supply per ItemType (NO_ITEM excluded). Always present, even pre-STARTGAME: counts are simply 0 until GetUnownedItems() fills them in, not omitted.

turnOrder.description: Player ids in turn order for this round; array position is the turn rank -- the old TURNORDER event's separate i_turnorder field was redundant with that position, so it's dropped here.

currentTurnPlayerId.description: Whose overall purchase-phase turn it currently is, or null once every player is done for the round.

currentBidderId.description: Whose turn it is to respond (raise/pass/pass out) in the current bid round -- independent of currentTurnPlayerId, since the player who opened the bid keeps their own turn throughout. Null outside state Bid.

supplyShip.description: The current supply ship's slots in order -- array position is the slot/shipIndex, each value an ItemType (NO_ITEM meaning empty). Always present, even pre-STARTGAME: it's simply [] until GetUnownedItems() is initialized, not omitted.

commodityStock.description: Central commodity market state per CommodityType (NO_COMMODITY excluded). Always present, even pre-STARTGAME: CommodityManager's decks are fully populated at construction time, so there's no uninitialized state to special-case, unlike supplyShip/itemStock.

purchaseData.description: What's been purchased from each supply-ship slot so far this turn; parallel to supplyShip by shipIndex.

myHand.description: This viewer's own real commodity hand (never another player's) -- null if the viewer isn't seated.

myPurchaseInfo.description: This viewer's own current purchase limits -- null if the viewer isn't seated.

manCost.description: Current per-man purchase cost; the only purchasable with a variable cost, hence BuyMen's own XML template instead of BuyThing's fixed iCOSTi.

megaRequest.description: Present only in state MegaResources, and only for the current-turn player being prompted -- null otherwise, including for every other viewer at the same moment.

bidInfo.description: Present only in state Bid; same for every viewer (not viewer-specific, unlike megaRequest).

itemShipIndex.description: The supplyShip slot currently up for bid -- index into supplyShip, not an ItemType itself.

winners.description: Winning player ids; empty except in TerminalState (more than one entry on a tie).
